scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The dance evolves from the Lindy Hop of 1920 and the Boogie Woogie of the 1940s.
By 1955, the rise of rock music shifts the style toward competitive acrobatics.
In the 1970s, dance schools in Lyon formalize the discipline, leading to the World Rock'N'Roll Confederation, or WRRC.
on_screen: Map: United States (origin), France (modern sport development) · Europe
Image 1 with attribution

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: Acrobatic Rock'n'Roll is primarily a competitive sport.
The WRRC organizes local, national, and international championships.
Dancers focus on precision, athleticism, and high-difficulty acrobatic execution.
It remains a living tradition today.
on_screen: Footage: File:Rock 'N' Roll (1959) Australian Film.webm (https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e0/Rock_%27N%27_Roll_%281959%29_Australian_Film.webm?utm_source=commons.wikimedia.org&utm_campaign=imageinfo&utm_content=original)

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: The dance relies on a 6-basic or 9-basic step structure.
The 9-basic step is the modern tournament standard, characterized by a 'kick-ball-change' maneuver.
Dancers move in a linear fashion, maintaining a precise, upright posture while executing kicks into the air.
Watch for Einsteiger, Körperwelle.
on_screen: Hero video full screen, 30–45 s (uvbLjBYyQ3c)
Captions name each signature move as it appears
Formation: Linear movement, pairs or formation groups.

scenes.title: Listen
narration: Music is in 4/4 time, typically modern disco or pop tracks between 176 and 208 bpm.
The rhythm stresses the first and third beats, unlike traditional rock music.
Listen for modern pop and disco instrumentation.
The pulse is 4/4 at about 192 beats a minute.
The driving beat supports rapid footwork and athletic movement.

scenes.title: The costume and the setting
narration: Dancers wear tight-fitting, multicoloured costumes made of elastic, durable artificial fibers to prevent snagging.
Footwear includes light jazz shoes for dance programs or aerobics sneakers for acrobatic programs to ensure grip and shock absorption.

Categories include Youth, Juniors, and Main Class in Contact Style and Free Style.

scenes.title: Family tree
narration: Acrobatic Rock'n'Roll descends from the Lindy Hop, the foundational swing dance that introduced acrobatic elements.
It also descends from Boogie Woogie, a faster swing adaptation that bridged the gap to rock music.
